text: Financial Aid & Scholarships. If you’ve got questions about scholarships or financial aid, you can learn all about our financial aid programs and support services by visiting the Office of Financial Aid website. You can even contact a Financial Aid Advisor and set up an appointment to discuss your options. If you’ve transferred to UT Dallas, you may be eligible for a Transfer Scholarship based on transferable hours, GPA, or Phi Theta Kappa membership. Please visit the Transfer Scholarship webpage to learn more about eligibility and renewal requirements. Scholarships are generally awarded based on academic merit. However, some awards consider financial need as an important qualification. We strongly encourage you to visit the Financial Aid website, explore the full range of scholarship opportunities at UT Dallas, and contact a Financial Aid advisor if you have any further questions about scholarships or other financial aid matters.
